tagline: Your judgment. A team of agents.
organizationDescription: A software lab directed by people, built with agents.
appDescription: Connects Skynot to your repositories: issues, branches and pull requests for a team of agents that works on orders you sign.

permissions.name: Contents
permissions.reason: Clone the repository and push work branches.

permissions.name: Issues
permissions.reason: Read labeled tickets, open and label the issue of each order.

permissions.name: Pull requests
permissions.reason: Open pull requests, read their state and diff, post the review verdict.

permissions.name: Actions
permissions.reason: Read the CI result of a pull request.

permissions.name: Metadata
permissions.reason: Base access GitHub includes in every installation.

permissions.name: Projects
permissions.reason: Move cards on an organization board, when a project names one.
